description: Ministry of Tourism Development & Chirstian Religions Affairs - Order to acquire the Land for Development of Tourism in Pavilupaddankaddykudiyeruppu, Mannar Town D/S Division, Mannar District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition for tourism development purposes. It specifically orders the acquisition of a defined parcel of land (145.4 hectares) under the Land Acquisitions Act, providing detailed location information including village, division, district, and boundary descriptions. While it mentions a government minister and references the Tourism Act, the core subject matter is the compulsory acquisition of land, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or structural announcement.
